d: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has tasked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot of the Yashar party with forming the country's next government following the inconclusive October 27 general election. Eisenkot has 28 days to secure the support of at least 61 Knesset members to form a majority, with a possible 14-day extension. The move sets the stage for crucial coalition negotiations that could determine Israel's political future.
